info.name: School Admin Backend — MUH Jain Global School
info.description: Every URL from docs/06-api.md. Base URL points at a local ./gradlew bootRun. Run 'Login > 1. Request OTP' then 'Login > 2. Verify OTP' first — the second call saves the token into the {{token}} collection variable automatically, and every other request sends it as a Bearer token.

request.description: Open URL. Same answer for a known or unknown phone. In dev/test the code is printed in the app console log (LogOtpSender).
Open URL. On 200, saves the JWT into the {{token}} collection variable for every other request.
Any login. Bumps token_version, kills every token for this user.
VEHICLES_EDIT. 409 VEHICLE_IN_USE if it runs a route.
VEHICLES_EDIT. A date that is null or left out removes that paper.
VEHICLES_EDIT. 409s: STAFF_BUSY, WRONG_STAFF_TYPE, LICENCE_ENDED, STAFF_INACTIVE, VEHICLE_INACTIVE, FROM_DATE_TOO_EARLY, TEMPORARY_OVERLAP.
VEHICLES_EDIT. 409 if still on a vehicle.
ROUTES_EDIT. 409 ROUTE_HAS_STUDENTS if children are on it.
ROUTES_EDIT. Sends the whole ordered list. A stop missing from the list is removed (409 STOP_HAS_STUDENTS if children board there).
STUDENTS_VIEW. Details, parents, bus now, photo flag.
STUDENTS_EDIT. 409 if it is the last phone.
STUDENTS_EDIT. To stop the bus send { "usesBus": false, "fromDate": "2026-12-01" }. Answer may include a ROUTE_FULL warning (not an error).
STUDENTS_EDIT. Multipart, JPEG or PNG, max 2 MB.
ADMISSIONS_CREATE. Student + parents + bus (+ fee plan from Phase 7) in one go.
TRIPS_RECORD or TRIPS_RECORD_ANY. One or many taps; one bad tap does not stop the others. outcome: DONE, ABSENT, NOT_TRAVELLING (evening only), CLEARED (undo).
BUS_STATUS_VIEW. Every child with the four events.
BUS_STATUS_VIEW. No taps, late buses, children missing in the evening.

item.name: Notifications (Phase 11)
item.description: docs/10-notifications.md. Owner only for now (MARKETING_VIEW / MARKETING_EDIT / MARKETING_SEND). Order: template → approve → draft → test → send → report.

item.name: Upload a poster, video or PDF

request.description: MARKETING_EDIT or MARKETING_SEND (owner for now). Multipart field `file`: JPEG/PNG 5 MB, MP4 16 MB, PDF 5 MB, audio 16 MB. Answers {mediaKey, mediaType, bytes, width, height, seconds}.
MARKETING_EDIT. Waits for approval. MARKETING/GREETING get the "Stop messages" button last. Every {box} needs an example.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "PTM",
  "kind": "NOTICE",
  "language": "hi",
  "body": "नमस्ते {Parent name} जी, {Child name} की PTM {Date} को सुबह 10 बजे है। — MUH Jain School",
  "smsBody": "{Child name}: PTM {Date} 10 बजे। MUH Jain School",
  "headerType": "NONE",
  "buttons": [],
  "exampleValues": {
    "Parent name": "Rajesh Punia",
    "Child name": "Aryan",
    "Date": "10 अक्टूबर"
  }
}

request.description: MARKETING_EDIT. An APPROVED one becomes a new version (new id, WAITING); the old one is turned off.
MARKETING_EDIT. Only with app.notifications.manual-approval=true (local, test); 404 in prod. REJECTED needs a reason.
MARKETING_SEND. A suggestion only, nothing saved. Every {box} must survive (409 REFINE_LOST_PLACEHOLDER). 409 REFINE_NOT_CONFIGURED without APP_AI_API_KEY.
MARKETING_SEND (kind checked in the service). Answers the counts of who gets it now. Nothing is sent.
MARKETING_VIEW. Newest first. Every filter optional.
MARKETING_VIEW. A draft or scheduled one has the counts of now.
MARKETING_SEND. Only DRAFT or SCHEDULED (409 NOTIFICATION_NOT_EDITABLE).
MARKETING_VIEW. Before sending: who would get it now. After: each row with status and skip reason. Phones masked.

item.name: Send a test to my phone

request.description: MARKETING_SEND. One TEST copy with the example values, not counted.
MARKETING_SEND. Only sets SENDING: the dispatcher writes the rows within a minute.
MARKETING_VIEW. Counts by status, channel, skip reason, failure reason, button; reads per hour. Never stored.
MARKETING_SEND. The FAILED rows worth a second try go back to the queue (same rows).
MARKETING_SEND. DRAFT/SCHEDULED: nothing sent. SENDING: the rows not sent yet are cancelled.
MARKETING_VIEW. Families who said stop to marketing and greetings. Phones masked.

item.name: Take a family off the stop list

request.description: MARKETING_SEND. 204; 404 when not on the list.
MARKETING_VIEW. Newest first. Full phone (to call back).
MARKETING_SEND. promisedUntil (today to 90 days) stops fee reminders until that day. makeEnquiry also needs ENQUIRIES_EDIT.

item.name: Provider callbacks (signed, no token)
item.description: No token. Each request is signed by its pre-request script with {{webhookSecret}} (local: the value in application-local.properties). Do not use {{variables}} inside these bodies: the signature is made on the raw text.

request.description: status: DELIVERED | READ | FAILED. In local the log sender's message ids are log-<outbox row id>.

exec: // The provider signs the raw body with the shared secret (HMAC-SHA256, hex).

request.description: A text or a buttonAction. "stop" / "बंद" / STOP_MESSAGES puts the family on the stop list.

exec: // The provider signs the raw body with the shared secret (HMAC-SHA256, hex).

item.name: Automatic messages (Phase 12)
item.description: docs/phases/phase-12-automatic-rules.md. A rule only makes a normal notification (source RULE); Phase 11 sends it. List needs MARKETING_VIEW, change and Run now need SETTINGS_EDIT (owner). Order: list → pick a template → turn on → Run now.

request.description: MARKETING_VIEW. The Settings table: every rule with template, audience, time (schedule), last run and the last 30 days' counts. Saves the first rule's id as ruleId.

item.name: Pick a template and turn on

request.description: SETTINGS_EDIT. Only what is sent changes. On needs an approved template of the rule's kind (409 RULE_NEEDS_TEMPLATE / TEMPLATE_NOT_FOR_KIND / TEMPLATE_NOT_APPROVED).
SETTINGS_EDIT. The switch on the Settings screen.
SETTINGS_EDIT. Timed rules only. DAILY (no days), WEEKLY (daysOfWeek), MONTHLY (daysOfMonth 1 to 28). The server builds the cron.
SETTINGS_EDIT. FESTIVAL only (use its id as ruleId): the whole list of dates and names for {Festival}.
SETTINGS_EDIT. Timed rules only (409 RULE_NEEDS_EVENT for WELCOME and BUS_LATE). Fires once now, even when off. Answers {status: CREATED|NOBODY, notificationId}; saves notificationId.

TRIPS_RECORD (log in as the attendant). Own route today only, else 403 NOT_YOUR_ROUTE. The families on that route get an URGENT message when the BUS_LATE rule is on; once per route per morning and per evening. Answers {routeId, minutes, willNotify, alreadySent}.
ENQUIRIES_VIEW. Count per stage, overdue count, admitted %.
ADMISSIONS_CREATE. Fields the admission form can copy.
FEES_VIEW. Plan, dues, payments, pending now, status.
FEES_CORRECT. Owner only. Negative row + note.
